title: Armed trespasser on Grillmair's property in December

tellings.quote: On December 20th, 2025, according to sheriff officials in court records, Carl Gilmer called the police to report someone trespassing on his sprawling lot in Lo.

plain: On December 20, 2025, a scientist named Carl Grillmair called the police to report an armed man trespassing on his large property in Llano, California, according to sheriff officials and court records. Michels tells this from those court records and reporting in the Los Angeles Times, in an episode about top American scientists who have gone missing. He brings it up as one of a string of troubling events around such scientists.
